text.tspan: 1) ACQUIRE (roster) — the visor delivers the story's keeper roster so the player can hot-fetch at replay time
2) LEGACY MIRROR (optional config) — the player still receives pushed chunks over RDMA, but replay no longer reads this in-memory window
3) REPLAY QUERY (watermark split) — hot from the keeper roster on demand, cold from the archive, cut at B = min(hot_floor)
unreachable / empty keeper reports hot_floor = UINT64_MAX and drops out of the min, so B only rises (archive covers the rest)
[each keeper in the roster (hot fetch, fan-out)]
4) ARCHIVE READ (cold) — separate reading ULT, cut at [start, B)
5) DELIVER — QueryResponseAgent drains ready responses to the client
6) STOP — the visor closes the story, pipeline retirement is deferred

svg.text: start_story_recording_with_keepers(chronicle, story, story_id, t0, keeper recording ServiceIds) [RPC]
setStoryKeepers(story_id, keeper_services) (replaced wholesale each story start)
receive_story_chunk(bulk, reporter) [RDMA] -> ingest -> collect / decay -> delete (archive already holds them)
story_playback_request(receiver, query_id, story_id, chronicle, story, start, end) [RPC]
hot_boundary = min(hot_boundary, hot_floor), merge events (dedup by EventSequence)
B = hot_boundary, keep hot events with time ≥ B (drop < B — archive-covered by E ≤ W)
prepend archived events, mark response ready
stopStoryRecording(story_id) (schedule pipeline exit at now + inactive_pipeline_delay)
